cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The pipe's still leaking. Which signature releases the repair money?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All three. I've spent all morning getting them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Could anyone still freeze it after your morning's work?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance could. Though they unfroze the roof payment when the caretaker called.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the caretaker have: permission to overrule finance, or someone else's direct number?
